simple.summary: תְּנוּמָה (tᵉnûwmâh) means drowsiness , i.e. sleep First listed occurrence: Job 33 15.

definitions.full: H8572. tenumah תְּנוּמָה noun feminine slumber ; — absolute Psa 132:4 ; Prov 6:4 ; plural תְּנוּמוֺת 6:10 2 t.; — slumber as time of visions Job 33:15 (|| תַּרְדֵּמָה ); of indolent slumber Psa 132:4 (|| שְׁנָת ) Prov 6:4 (|| שׁנה ) in both with נָחַן , followed by accusative + לְ ; 6:10 ; 24:33 (both || שׁכב שׁנות, ).
